basic_info.description: Architecturally Stunning, a Dynamic Renovation One Block to Cole Street Shops. Renowned architects of Dumican Mosey have skillfully reimagined this Victorian residence. Upon entering the striking facade of this classic Queen Anne Victorian, one is greeted by a modern masterpiece featuring a three-story living wall, a stately gas fireplace, an open floor plan spanning the home's footprint, soaring ceilings, and top notch finishes. Floor-to-ceiling Fleetwood doors glide open to reveal a deck overlooking the property's lower level patio and yard. The upper bedroom level hosts a desirable 4-bedroom floor plan, while the lower level's media room, wet bar, walk-out patio and additional bedroom and bathroom do not disappoint. You'll find a large 2-car garage with plenty of room for storing bikes, surfboards and the works.  4,580 square feet of meticulously crafted living space, designed with unparalleled quality and attention to detail, 164 Belvedere stands as a distinctive luxury property, captivating at every turn. Formerly owned by Baron Wolman, the first photographer for Rolling Stone magazine, this home has a rich legacy in the music scene, having hosted icons such as Janis Joplin, Jerry Garcia, and the Grateful Dead.
